strings.setup.title: Baakanya polasi ya gago
strings.setup.welcome.title: O amogetswe mo AgroFlow
strings.setup.welcome.body: A re baakanye polasi ya gago. Go tsaya metsotso e ka nna 10, mme o ka emisa wa tswelela moragonyana.
strings.setup.welcome.why: Tlhopha puo e o e balang bobotlana. O ka e fetola nako nngwe le nngwe mo Dithulaganyong.
strings.setup.welcome.tip: Tobetsa puo mme appe e fetoga ka bonako.
strings.setup.password.title: Baya lefoko la gago la sephiri
strings.setup.password.why: Ke wena fela yo o tshwanetseng go le itse. Le o tsenneng ka lone e ne e le la nakwana.
strings.setup.password.save: Boloka lefoko la me la sephiri
strings.setup.password.saved: Lefoko la gago la sephiri le bolokilwe.
strings.setup.password.already: Lefoko la gago la sephiri le setse le beilwe. O ka le fetola moragonyana mo Porofaeleng.
strings.setup.password.mismatch: Mafoko a mabedi a sephiri ga a tshwane.
strings.setup.password.failed: Lefoko la sephiri ga le a kgona go bolokwa. Tlhola kgolagano mme o leke gape.
strings.setup.password.tip: Tlhopha sengwe se o se itseng o le esi, se se nang le nomoro.
strings.setup.telegram.title: Golaganya Telegram
strings.setup.telegram.why: Telegram ke tsela e AgroFlow e go romelang ditemoso ka yone, le tsela e o bonang lefoko le lesha la sephiri fa o lebetse la gago.
strings.setup.telegram.linked: Telegram e golagane. Ditemoso di tla go fitlhela koo.
strings.setup.telegram.tip: Tlogela dikitsiso tsa Telegram di dirile, gore temoso ya karolo e e omileng e tsose founu ya gago.
strings.setup.zones.title: Dikarolo tsa gago
strings.setup.zones.why: AgroFlow e bala metsi go ya ka sejalo sengwe le sengwe le bogolo jwa sone, ka jalo tlhola se se golang le gore se jadilwe leng.
strings.setup.zones.plantedQ: O jadile e ka nna leng?
strings.setup.zones.none: Ga go ise go nne le dikarolo. Motlhokomedi wa tshimo wa AgroFlow o a di oketsa.
strings.setup.zones.tip: Ga o tlhomamise letlha? Kakanyetso e siame; o ka e baakanya moragonyana.
strings.setup.flow.title: Lekanya go elela ga metsi a gago
strings.setup.flow.why: AgroFlow e tlhoka go itse gore metsi a tswa ka bonako bo kae, go go bolelela gore o nosetse metsotso e le kae.
strings.setup.flow.how: Tshwara sejana ka fa tlase ga pompo kgotsa phaephe. Tobetsa Simolola fa metsi a tsena, le Emisa fa se tletse.
strings.setup.flow.sizeInvalid: Tsenya gore sejana se tshola bokae (go feta 0).
strings.setup.flow.timeInvalid: Lekanya go feta metsotswana e le 2. Dirisa sejana se segolo fa se tlala ka bonako thata.
strings.setup.flow.tip: Dirisa pakete kgotsa sejana sefe kapa sefe. Se tlatse go fitlha kwa mothalong o o o itseng, mme o kwale gore ke dilitara di le kae.
strings.setup.soil.title: Ruta AgroFlow ka mmu wa gago
strings.setup.soil.why: Mmu mongwe le mongwe o tshola metsi ka tsela e e farologaneng. Dipalo di le pedi di bontsha AgroFlow gore mmu wa gago o lebega jang fa o omile le fa o le metsi.
strings.setup.soil.noKit: {zone}: go letetswe sedirisiwa. Se se tla bulega fa sedirisiwa se golagane.
strings.setup.soil.noKits: Ga go na karolo epe e e nang le sedirisiwa, ka jalo ga go na sepe sa go dira fano jaanong.
strings.setup.soil.dryHow: Fa mmu o omile, jaaka pele o nosetsa:
strings.setup.soil.dry: Boloka palo ya mmu o omileng jaanong
strings.setup.soil.wetHow: Nosetsa sentle, leta go fitlha ka moso, morago:
strings.setup.soil.wet: Boloka palo ya mmu o metsi
strings.setup.soil.reminder: Re tla go gakolola mo Gae go boloka palo ya mmu o metsi.
strings.setup.soil.kitOffline: Sedirisiwa ga se a araba. O ka tswelela mme o dire se moragonyana.
strings.setup.soil.tip: Dira palo ya mmu o omileng pele o nosetsa.
strings.setup.done.title: Go siame
strings.setup.done.why: Se se dirilweng le se se santseng se tshwanetse go dirwa ke se.
strings.setup.done.todo: Go santse go tshwanetse go dirwa
strings.setup.task.zones: Dijalo le malatsi a go jala
strings.setup.card.title: Thulaganyo {done}/{total} e dirilwe
strings.setup.card.wet: Mmu: boloka palo ya mmu o metsi bakeng sa {zone}
strings.setup.location.title: A e ke polase ya gago?
strings.setup.location.why: Motlhankedi wa gago wa masimo o bolokile fa polase ya gago e leng teng. AgroFlow e e dirisetsa maemo a bosa le ditlhagiso go tswa go balemi ba ba gaufi.
strings.setup.location.unknown: Ga go na lefelo le le bolokilweng
strings.setup.location.noPoint: Ga go ise go nne le ntlha ya mmapa ya polase ya gago. Motlhankedi wa gago a ka e tsenya.
strings.setup.location.mapA11y: Mmapa wa polase ya gago gaufi le {place}
strings.setup.location.wrong: Sengwe se phoso — bolelela motlhankedi wa me
strings.setup.location.sent: Re a leboga. Motlhankedi wa gago o tla tlhola lefelo la polase ya gago.
strings.setup.water.title: Metsi a gago a tswa kae?
strings.setup.water.why: Fa o nosetsa ka metsi a tanka, AgroFlow e tla ela tlhoko gore go setse a le kae.
strings.setup.tank.title: Tanka ya gago
strings.setup.tank.why: Ka bogolo le gore e tletse go le kae jaanong, AgroFlow e ka go bolelela gore o setse le metsi a malatsi a le kae.
strings.setup.tank.size: E tshwara metsi a le kae?
strings.setup.tank.howFull: E tletse go le kae jaanong?
strings.setup.tank.nearlyEmpty: E batla e se na sepe
strings.setup.tank.ph: pH ya metsi, fa o e itse (o ka e tlogela)
strings.setup.tank.needSize: Tlhopha gore tanka e tshwara metsi a le kae.
strings.setup.tank.needLevel: Tlhopha gore e tletse go le kae jaanong.
strings.setup.tank.badPh: pH ke palo go tloga go 0 go ya go 14.
strings.setup.irrigation.title: {zone} e nosediwa jang?
strings.setup.irrigation.why: Metsi mangwe a latlhega pele a fitlha kwa medung. Go conta go latlha a mannye, mosele o latlha a mantsi, ka jalo AgroFlow e oketsa go le gonnye go ya ka tsela e o nosetsang ka yone.
strings.setup.soilType.title: Mmu wa {zone} o ntse jang?
strings.setup.soilType.why: Mmu wa motlhaba o oma ka bonako mme letsopa le tshwara metsi lobaka lo loleele, ka jalo AgroFlow e nosetsa mongwe le mongwe ka tsela e e farologanang.
strings.setup.soilType.sandyDesc: Go utlwala go le makwata mme o phatlalala mo seatleng, le fa o le metsi.
strings.setup.soilType.loam: Mmu o o tlwaelegileng wa tshingwana
strings.setup.soilType.loamDesc: O lefifi e bile o a phuthologa. Seatla se se metsi se a kgomarela, morago se robege.
strings.setup.soilType.clayDesc: Le a kgomarela fa le le metsi, le thata e bile le a phatloga fa le omile.
strings.setup.size.title: {zone} e kgolo go le kae?
strings.setup.size.why: Bogolo bo fetola metsi a sejalo se a tlhokang go nna dilitara.
strings.setup.size.label: Bogolo
strings.setup.maxRun.title: Nako e telele ya go nosetsa ka nako nngwe
strings.setup.maxRun.why: Pompo ga e ke e bereka go feta fa ka nako nngwe, go e sireletsa le go thibela metsi go elela.
strings.setup.maxRun.ask: Kopa motlhankedi wa gago go fetola se.
strings.setup.alerts.title: O batla ditlhagiso dife?
strings.setup.alerts.why: Tlhagiso nngwe le nngwe e bonala mo appeng. Tlhopha tse di tla tlang gape kwa Telegram.
strings.setup.alerts.community: Dipego go tswa go balemi ba ba gaufi
strings.setup.alerts.noTelegram: Golaganya Telegram go di amogela gape mo founung ya gago.

strings.setup.community.title: Ditlhagiso go tswa go balemi ba ba gaufi
strings.setup.community.why: Balemi ba ka tlhagisana ka disenyi, malwetse a dijalo, molelo, mathata a metsi le bosa jo bo maswe. Leina la gago ga le ke le bontshiwa.
strings.setup.community.limit: Polase nngwe le nngwe e ka tsenya dipego di le 2 mo diureng dingwe le dingwe di le 36, gore ditlhagiso di nne mosola. Go re "Le nna ke a se bona" ga go balwe.

strings.tasks.title: Dintlha tsa gago
strings.tasks.why: Ditiro di le nne tse dikhutshwane. Araba se o se itseng; tobetsa Ga ke itse – nthuse mo go se se setseng, mme badiri ba AgroFlow ba tla thusa.

strings.terms.title: Pele o simolola
strings.terms.summary: AgroFlow ke tirelo: sedirisiwa sa kwa tshimong, appe e, le thuso go tswa go badiri ba AgroFlow. Tsweetswee bala melawana le kitsiso ya sephiri. Tsotlhe ke ditokomane tsa tshekatsheko tse di santseng di tlhoka go dumelelwa.
strings.terms.weDo: AgroFlow e tsenya e bile e leka sedirisiwa, e tsamaisa appe le dikgakololo, e lekanyetsa go nosetsa go ya ka tekanyetso ya tshimo, mme e thusa fa o kopa.
strings.terms.youDo: O boloka lefoko la sephiri e le la gago, o boloka sedirisiwa se na le motlakase, o tlhatlhoba dijalo mme o bolelela AgroFlow fa sengwe se sa siama.
strings.terms.limits: Go nosetsa go tlhoka sedirisiwa, motlakase le kgolagano. Fa sedirisiwa se sa arabe, appe e bolela Ga go na karabo go na le go itira e kete go dirile.
strings.terms.accept: Ke badile e bile ke amogela melawana ya tirelo le kitsiso ya sephiri.
strings.terms.tickFirst: Tshwaya lebokose go amogela melawana le kitsiso ya sephiri.
strings.terms.unavailable: Melawana ga e a kgona go tsenngwa. Tlhatlhoba kgolagano o bo o leke gape.
strings.terms.loadFailed: Tokomane ga e a kgona go tsenngwa.
strings.terms.optionalSeparate: Telegram, dipego tsa baagisani le lefelo la mogala wa gago di nna ditlhopho tse di farologaneng. O ka di fetola nako nngwe le nngwe mo Dipeakanyong.
strings.terms.englishOnly: Ditshekatsheko tse di ka Seesemane ga jaana. Diphetolelo di tla latela fa ditokomane di dumeletswe.
strings.service.title: Tirelo le thuso
strings.service.unavailable: Dintlha tsa tirelo ga di a kgona go tsenngwa.
strings.service.status.paying: e a dira (tirelo e e duelwang)
strings.service.example: Sekao sa tlhwatlhwa: {install} go tsenya (le sedirisiwa) le {monthly} ka kgwedi, mo polaseng ya dikarolo di le {zones}. Tlhwatlhwa ya bofelo e tla morago ga ketelo.
strings.service.noPayments: AgroFlow ga e amogele dituelo mo appeng.
strings.service.helpInApp: Bula Thuso mo appeng, kgotsa tobetsa Ga ke itse – nthuse mo potsong nngwe le nngwe ya go baakanya.
strings.service.helpTelegram: Fa o golagantse Telegram, romela molaetsa go bot ya AgroFlow.
